experimental_scope: Pretrained SmolLM2-135M native GQA, FP32 model, 64 key centroid reps out of P128, ideal Q4K4 signed dot, physically stored FP16 centroid V, exact suffix+fallback, software CPU

strict_four.selection_policy: predeclared: each admitted layer must have delta NLL <=0 on both calibration domains and combined delta NLL <=0.05 on each calibration domain; zero access to held-out third domain

full_P128_identity.caveat: Earlier eight-token repeat-passage control, not directly comparable with nonrepeated 31-target policy comparisons

source_silicon_macro_geometry.quality_label: hypothetical Llama geometry only; no Llama8B compressed-prefix inference

scope_limits: One 135M checkpoint, one P128 prefix, three authored domains and 31 heldout targets: no confidence intervals or publication-ready generalization.
Layer selection requires real model inference and is calibrated offline; calibration overhead must be amortized over requests sharing a prefix.
GPU fallback was exact software attention executed on CPU; GPU speed and energy not measured.
Signed Q4K4 math is ideal, not a characterized Sinangil O4 ADC response.
Only K/V/metadata complete macro areas are accounted; digital/control/programming, centroid assignment and interconnect have no area/performance evidence.

Count-weighted centroid attention and softmax suffix fusion derive from prior art (Multipole Attention and Hydragen). Novelty would depend on the joint physical-aware quality admission and competitive baseline evidence.
Neither Llama8B quality, OPT, Mistral model inference, nor full decoder speedup shown.
